chapter: Philadelphia, Detroit and back to Atlantic City
title: Baron Wilkins hires him for New York
summary: Baron Wilkins, the boss of Harlem, offers Wooding a job at his cabaret at about forty dollars a week and the men less.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So, anyhow, we got along very nicely. But before the season was over, a man came down from New York, which everybody knew at that time was the boss of Harlem, was Baron Wilkins. Baron Wilkins come down and said he was looking for a band. And he asked Charley Reynolds, "What about the band you've got?" Because the season was about to close down there. So, Charley Reynolds said, "Hey this guy is good. He's a young kid, he's trying to get going and one thing, he tends to business. I don't know what he does after the business, but he really tends to business while he's on the job." See, so Baron come in and said to me, "Son, would you like to come to New York?" Well, that's where I wanted to go. I'd been wanting to go there. It was my Mecca. So, I told him, "Sure, what job do you have there", and he said, "In my cabaret." So I said, "Well, I'd be delighted, Mr. Baron, so we get together on the price. Well, we did get together on the price. I got something like $40.00 a week, and the men got something like $25. or $30. a week. Anyhow, I came to New York.
